pages.text: $(t4)Tier 4$() is the apex of the Engineering lane. The $(bold)Fission Reactor$() is your first reactor and the start of the polonium road; the $(bold)Fusion Reactor$() is the power capstone - the largest sustained RF source in the pack.

pages.title: Antimatter
pages.text: Fusion exists to feed the $(bold)Supercharged Particle Accelerator (SPS)$(): polonium pellets plus colossal RF produce $(bold)Antimatter Pellets$(), the rarest engineering output. The SPS is the RF-hyperscaling sink the whole tree was climbing toward.

pages.title: Spending it
pages.text: Antimatter is the hard reagent behind the pack's top-tier crafts - the $(bold)Mythic Catalyst$() line (combat endgame) and the $(bold)MekaSuit Mk2$() upgrade (tech-armor endgame). Engineering's apex output feeds the pack's apex gear.$(br2)$(note)NOTE: the antimatter sinks are tracked in the T4 questline's final beat; see $(l:icraft:mods_t4/mekanism_advanced)Mekanism Advanced$(/l) for the apex-tech overview.$()
